content.user_title: Evaluate Code Review Feedback with Technical Rigor
content.value_statement: The wrong review change can introduce regressions or unnecessary complexity. This skill helps users verify feedback, clarify requirements, respond with evidence, and implement accepted changes incrementally.
actual_capabilities: Structures feedback handling into reading, understanding, verification, evaluation, response, and implementation.
Identifies when clarification should precede implementation.
Guides evaluation against current behavior, compatibility, tests, usage, and architecture.
Prioritizes blocking, simple, and complex review items.
Provides response patterns for agreement, pushback, corrections, and GitHub review threads.
limitations: Does not inspect code or run tests without access to project tools.
Cannot resolve ambiguous requirements without user or reviewer input.
Provides workflow guidance, not language-specific implementation rules.
Does not replace security review, maintainer decisions, or project documentation.

use_cases.title: Validate pull request feedback
use_cases.description: Check whether requested changes fit existing behavior before editing the code.

use_cases.title: Coordinate team reviews
use_cases.description: Clarify related comments, prioritize accepted fixes, and track verification for each change.

use_cases.title: Respond to external contributors
use_cases.description: Assess suggestions against project constraints and provide concise, evidence-based replies.

prompt_templates.title: Review one comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this review comment: [comment]. Restate the requested change, identify missing context, and list what to verify before implementation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one clear comment

prompt_templates.title: Clarify multiple comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these comments: [comments]. Group related items, identify every ambiguity, and draft focused clarification questions before any implementation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review with related or unclear items

prompt_templates.title: Assess a questionable suggestion
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [suggestion] against [codebase context]. Check behavior, compatibility, usage, tests, and architecture. Recommend acceptance, revision, or evidence-based pushback.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced technical evaluation of disputed feedback

prompt_templates.title: Execute a verified review plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [comments] against [repository context]. Separate accepted, rejected, and unclear items. Prioritize accepted fixes, implement each separately, and report verification results.

output_examples.input: Reviewer says: Remove the compatibility branch because it is old.
output: Verification needed: Confirm supported platforms and relevant tests before removal.
Response: This branch supports the documented minimum version, so removal would break compatibility.

output_examples.input: The reviewer requests six fixes, but items four and five are unclear.
output: Understood: Items one, two, three, and six.
Blocked: Items four and five need clarification before related changes begin.
Next step: Ask focused questions about the expected behavior for both items.

output_examples.input: A reviewer identifies an incorrect import and the tests confirm the issue.
output_examples.output: Fixed the import and reran the affected tests. All targeted tests pass.

best_practices: Read all feedback and clarify related ambiguities before changing code.
Verify each suggestion against usage, compatibility, architecture, and tests.
Implement accepted items individually and test after every change.
anti_patterns: Agreeing or implementing before confirming technical correctness.
Applying understood items while related feedback remains unclear.
Rejecting feedback defensively without evidence from code, tests, or requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically accept reviewer feedback?
faq.answer: No. It treats feedback as a suggestion that requires technical verification.

faq.question: Can it help with unclear review comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies ambiguities and prompts focused clarification before implementation.

faq.question: Does the skill run project tests?
faq.answer: It recommends targeted testing. Test execution depends on available project tools and permissions.

faq.question: How does it handle an incorrect suggestion?
faq.answer: It checks available evidence and supports concise pushback grounded in behavior, tests, compatibility, or architecture.

faq.question: Does it support GitHub review replies?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends replying within the relevant inline comment thread.

faq.question: Can it make final architecture decisions?
faq.answer: No. Conflicts with established architecture should be escalated to the responsible maintainer.
